name: English - English Through Cinema C1
description:
Our focus this semester is: Sustainable Worlds and Dystopian Futures.

Sessions will include film screenings and in-depth discussion of various aspects of culture and communication. During the course of the semester, you'll be able to find a list at moodle showing which films will be viewed in each session.

The films viewed this semester will all focus on the portrayal of science and technology in popular films, even venturing into the realm of speculative fiction.
